suppressPackageStartupMessages\({
  library\(limma\)
  library\(dplyr\)
  library\(tidyr\)
  library\(ggplot2\)
  library\(ggrepel\)
  library\(patchwork\)
}\)

source\(""scripts/support_functions.R""\)
source\(""scripts/config/analysis_config.R""\)
source\(""scripts/config/contrasts.R""\)
source\(""scripts/config/plotting_themes.R""\)

zonation_dir <- ""results/zonation""
load\(file.path\(zonation_dir, ""zonation_ttop_list.RData""\)\)

t_table <- ttop_list_to_t_table\(ttop_list\)
comparisons <- list\(
  ""portal_vs_Central"" = c\(-1, -3, 2, 4\),
  ""testes_vs_ova"" = c\(-1, -2, 3, 4\),
  ""portalova_vs_centralova"" = c\(-1, 2\),
  ""portaltestes_vs_centraltestes"" = c\(-3, 4\),
  ""centraltestes_vs_centralova"" = c\(-1, 3\),
  ""portaltestes_vs_portalova"" = c\(-2, 4\),
  ""testes_effect_zonation"" = c\(-3, 4, 1, -2\)
\)
names\(t_table\) <- c\(""gene"", names\(comparisons\)\)

cat\(""t_table:"", nrow\(t_table\), ""x"", ncol\(t_table\), ""\\n""\)

optimal_threshold <- 3.2

sex_bias_data <- t_table[, c\(""gene"", ""portaltestes_vs_portalova"",
                              ""centraltestes_vs_centralova"",
                              ""testes_effect_zonation""\)]
names\(sex_bias_data\) <- c\(""gene"", ""pp_sex_bias"", ""pc_sex_bias"", ""interaction""\)

sex_bias_data$category <- ""None""
sig_interaction <- abs\(sex_bias_data$interaction\) > optimal_threshold
pp_dominant <- abs\(sex_bias_data$pp_sex_bias\) > abs\(sex_bias_data$pc_sex_bias\)
sex_bias_data$category[sig_interaction & pp_dominant] <- ""Periportal-specific""
sex_bias_data$category[sig_interaction & !pp_dominant] <- ""Pericentral-specific""
sex_bias_data$category <- factor\(sex_bias_data$category,
                                  levels = c\(""Pericentral-specific"", ""Periportal-specific"", ""None""\)\)

cat\(""Pericentral-specific:"", sum\(sex_bias_data$category == ""Pericentral-specific""\), ""\\n""\)
cat\(""Periportal-specific:"", sum\(sex_bias_data$category == ""Periportal-specific""\), ""\\n""\)
cat\(""Non-specific:"", sum\(sex_bias_data$category == ""None""\), ""\\n""\)

sex_bias_data$diag_distance <- abs\(sex_bias_data$pp_sex_bias - sex_bias_data$pc_sex_bias\) / sqrt\(2\)
labeled_sex_bias <- sex_bias_data[sex_bias_data$category != ""None"", ]
labeled_sex_bias <- labeled_sex_bias[order\(-labeled_sex_bias$diag_distance\), ]
n_labels <- 5
top_pp <- head\(labeled_sex_bias[labeled_sex_bias$category == ""Periportal-specific"", ], n_labels\)
top_pc <- head\(labeled_sex_bias[labeled_sex_bias$category == ""Pericentral-specific"", ], n_labels\)
genes_to_label <- c\(top_pp$gene, top_pc$gene\)
cat\(""Labeling:"", paste\(genes_to_label, collapse="", ""\), ""\\n""\)

sex_bias_scatter <- ggplot\(sex_bias_data, aes\(x = pp_sex_bias, y = pc_sex_bias\)\) +
  geom_abline\(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = ""dashed"", color = ""gray60"", linewidth = 0.5\) +
  geom_abline\(slope = 1, intercept = optimal_threshold * 2, linetype = ""dashed"",
              color = ""gray75"", linewidth = 0.3\) +
  geom_abline\(slope = 1, intercept = -optimal_threshold * 2, linetype = ""dashed"",
              color = ""gray75"", linewidth = 0.3\) +
  geom_point\(data = sex_bias_data[sex_bias_data$category == ""None"", ],
             color = ""#cccccc"", alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2\) +
  geom_point\(data = sex_bias_data[sex_bias_data$category != ""None"", ],
             aes\(color = category\), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8\) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel\(
    data = sex_bias_data[sex_bias_data$gene %in% genes_to_label, ],
    aes\(label = gene, color = category\),
    size = 3.2, fontface = ""italic"",
    max.overlaps = 20,
    segment.size = 0.3, segment.alpha = 0.6,
    box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  \) +
  scale_color_manual\(
    values = c\(""Pericentral-specific"" = ""#e54141"",
               ""Periportal-specific"" = ""#4173d8""\),
    name = NULL
  \) +
  scale_y_reverse\(\) +
  labs\(x = ""PP gene expression sex bias\\n\(t-value\)"",
       y = ""PC gene expression sex bias\\n\(t-value\)""\) +
  theme_classic\(\) +
  theme\(legend.position = ""top"", aspect.ratio = 1\)

ggsave\(file.path\(zonation_dir, ""zone_specific_sex_bias_scatter.pdf""\),
       plot = sex_bias_scatter, width = 6, height = 6.5\)

cat\(""Done! Saved.\\n""\)
')
